title: Datasource table sync: the generated object draft gives its fields no label, so forms show raw column names; where the synced object lives (package, export) is unstated
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVwQZbHRRM9CaXeKif

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing and a measured reproduction. Filed by the `domain:ui#5` seat from #30328 (filed by epic:#26676#1 from a real-user browser walkthrough of Setup on `main` `04f36b63f8`). #30328 names the server lane as a reader for the generated object draft. This card carries that half. Carrier: the server lane.

**Business reason.** After an administrator syncs a table from an external database, the new-record form labels its inputs with raw column names (`part_no`). The list on the same object reads `Part name`. Every member who later opens that form sees database column names in place of field names.

**Reader.** The server lane dev in `packages/services/service-datasource/src/external-datasource-service.ts` (the object-draft generator).

## Observed

- #30328 measured, after syncing `spare_parts` from an external SQLite file: the list labels read `Part name`, and the new-record form reads `part_no`.
- On `origin/main` the draft generator writes each field as `fields[fieldName] = { type: fieldType }` (the column loop just before the ADR-0028 namespace block, around line 918). No field carries a `label`. The object itself gets a label derived from the short name, but its fields do not.
- #30328 also measured `/api/v1/meta/object` reporting the synced object's package as `sys_metadata`, which means it is in no package. #28569 describes a package-less row as one that never exports. Export was not tested.

## Wanted

- The generated draft gives each field a readable label, derived the same way the object's own label is derived. How the label is derived is the server lane's call.
- The dev reads ADR-0146 to settle where a synced object should live. The PR says whether such an object exports.

## Not in scope

- The after-sync note in Setup that links to the new object and says what is left (add to an app, grant access). That is the `domain:ui` half of #30328.
- The zh create-form title `新建Spare Parts` (no space between 新建 and a Latin name). That is #30126 item 1.

Refs: #30328.
Dedupe words: datasource draft field label, synced object form label raw column name, external datasource object draft label, synced object package export. Searched `is:issue datasource draft field label column name` (295 hits, all QA run anchors at the top, none on the draft's field labels) and `is:issue synced object package sys_metadata export datasource` (11 hits: #30328 itself and closed datasource-routing cards, none on this subject).
